title: Grateful Dead Live at Copps Coliseum on 1990-03-22
lineage: Charlie Miller Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Flac 16/48  Edited & reMastered by Joe Noel Flac 16/48 > Audacity > 16/48 September 26, 2018
source: Ted Mattes Recording: Schoeps CMC5 MK4 > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250) Location: row 23 seat 10

ai_review.summary: A superb audience recording that eclipses many soundboard tapes, capturing one of the best shows of the 1990 spring tour.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about this audience source, saying it leaves typical soundboard recordings in the dust and delivers crystal‑clear detail. They also label the concert as one of the top performances from Spring ’90, noting its bittersweet context with Brent Mydland’s upcoming departure. No specific songs are called out, but the overall impression is overwhelmingly positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Single glowing review praises both the musical performance and the audience recording quality; limited data prevents high confidence.
